records.public_safe_text: unit 1 was driving northeast on canyon creek circle completing the afternoon bus route. the driver of unit 1 stopped at 401 canyon creek circle and three students exited the bus. the first student to exit, for crash reports purposes, will be identified as unit 2. unit 2 exited unit 1 and ran to the front unit 1, unit 2 then turned around and went into the east barrow ditch. it is unclear as to what unit 2 was doing in the barrow ditch. at this time, the other two students exited unit 1 and cleared the front of unit 1. while the last student was walking in front of unit 1, unit 2 started to walk in front of unit 1 from the right. the driver of unit 1 was watching the last student and apparently did not see unit 2 and began to move unit 1. unit 1 then struck unit 2 causing unit 2 to go under the right side of the unit 1 where unit 2 was ran over by the front right and rear right tires of unit 1. once the driver of unit 1 realized that he had ran something over he pulled unit 1 over to the right and angled unit 1 to block the roadway. unit 1 came to rest [school facility] district had the driver of unit 1 tested for any intoxicants and toxicology results were negative.
